# x402 APIs

> Pay-per-call scanning APIs for AI agents at x402.agiscorecard.com. No account, no API key: each call costs $0.005, paid in USDC on Base via the open x402 payment-required protocol (HTTP 402 → sign EIP-3009 USDC authorization → retry with X-PAYMENT header → JSON result + on-chain settlement receipt). Failed scans are never charged.

## Paid API endpoints (x402 v1, "exact" scheme, USDC on Base)
- `GET /api/scan?url=<site>` — agent-readiness scan of any website (robots.txt AI-crawler access, llms.txt, agents.md, JSON-LD structured data, meta, sitemap; 0-100 score with itemized checks and fixes). $0.005/call.
- `GET /api/mcp-check?url=<mcp endpoint>` — MCP server health check (real JSON-RPC initialize + tools/list handshake: protocol version, serverInfo, capabilities, tool docs quality, latency, TLS, auth posture; 0-100 score). $0.005/call.

## How to pay
1. Call the endpoint with no X-PAYMENT header → HTTP 402 with `accepts[]` payment requirements (amount in atomic USDC units: "5000" = $0.005; asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913; network "base").
2. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the amount, retry with `X-PAYMENT: base64(JSON payload)`.
3. Response 200 carries the result plus `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` (base64 settlement receipt with tx hash). Client libraries: `x402-fetch` (protocol v1) handles the whole flow.

## Discovery
- `GET /.well-known/x402` — machine-readable catalog: path, method, price, network, payTo-configured boolean.
